Name: AppVersion
Description: Displays the wiki engine version.

Name: Attachments
Description: Lists the attached files associated with a page.

Name: Background
Description: Set the background color for a block of content.

Name: Blockquote
Description: Blockquotes are good for quoting blocks of content from another source within your document.

Name: BR
Description: Inserts one or more line-breaks into the wiki body.

Name: Bullets
Description: Create hierarchical ordered or unordered lists.

Name: Callout
Description: Prominently display useful information in a fairly understated panel.

Name: Card
Description: Cards are good for displaying every-day content and can have a title.

Name: Code
Description: Display formatted, wiki-unprocessed and syntax-hilighted code.
TemplateText:
{{Code()
SELECT
	*
FROM
    Employees as E
INNER JOIN Company as C
    ON C.Id = E.CompanyId
}}

Name: Collapse
Description: Dynamically show or hide a section of the wiki body.

Name: Color
Description: Set the color of a portion of text.

Name: Created
Description: Displays the created date/time of the page.

Name: DefineSnippet
Description: Sets a snippet variable to a block of wiki markup.

Name: Deprecate
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page needs to be deleted.

Name: Description
Description: Displays the description of the wiki page.

Name: Draft
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page is in draft - is incomplete.

Name: EditLink
Description: Insert a link to quickly edit the page.

Name: Figure
Description: Displays a piece of content along with an optional caption, especially useful for images.

Name: File
Description: Insert file download links into the wiki body.

Name: Foreground
Description: Set the foreground color for a block of content.

Name: Get
Description: Get wiki page variable value.

Name: HideFooterComments
Description: Indicates that comments should not display comments at the bottom regardless of the system settings.

Name: HR
Description: Inserts a horizontal rule (divider) into the wiki bosy.

Name: Image
Description: Display images in the wiki body.

Name: Include
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page is an include and not a while page.

Name: Include
Description: Inserts the processed wiki body of one page into the calling page.

Name: Inject
Description: Inserts the un-processed wiki body of one page into the calling page.

Name: Jumbotron
Description: Large grey box good for calling attention in a non-critical way.

Name: LastModified
Description: Displays the modified date/time of the page.

Name: Literals
Description: Literal blocks for displaying verbatim content.

Name: Name
Description: Displays the pages name.

Name: Namespace
Description: Displays the namespace of the wiki page.

Name: NamespaceGlossary
Description: Create a glossary from of pages in specified namespaces.

Name: NamespaceList
Description: Create a list of pages from specified namespaces.

Name: Navigation
Description: Diaplys the URL friendly navigation name of a page.

Name: NoCache
Description: Processing instruction indicating that the page should never be cached.

Name: Order
Description: Orders the resulting lines of a block of wiki markup.
TemplateText:
{{Order
This
Is
A
List
Of
Lines
To
Sort
}}

Name: Protect
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page is protected from unauthorized modification.

Name: RecentlyModified
Description: Display a list of recently modified wiki pages.

Name: Related
Description: Create a list of related pages based on incoming links.

Name: Review
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page needs to be reviewed.

Name: Revisions
Description: Displays the revision history of a page.

Name: SearchCloud
Description: Create a cloud of pages from a search of wiki body contents.

Name: SearchList
Description: Create  a list from a search of wiki body contents.

Name: Seq
Description: Automatically create a numbered sequence on a page.
TemplateText:
**##Seq** - This is my first point.
You can have content between the sequences.
**##Seq** - This is my second point.
You can have additional content between the sequences.
**##Seq** - This is my third point.

Name: Set
Description: Set wiki page variable value.

Name: Similar
Description: Create a list of similar pages based on tag similarities.

Name: SiteName
Description: Displays the name of the configured site.

Name: Snippet
Description: Injects the value of a previously defined snippet variable.

Name: StripedTable
Description: The StripedTable scope function allows you to create tables with columns and alternating colored rows.
TemplateText:
{{StripedTable
Column #1 || Column #2 || Column #3 || Column #4
Row #1 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #2 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #3 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #4 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
}}

Name: Table
Description: The Table scope function allows you to create tables with rows and columns.
TemplateText:
{{Table
Column #1 || Column #2 || Column #3 || Column #4
Row #1 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #2 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #3 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
Row #4 || Cell #1 || Cell #2 || Cell #3
}}

Name: TagCloud
Description: Create a tag cloud from a seed tag.

Name: TagGlossary
Description: Create a glossary from a search of specified tags.

Name: TagList
Description: Create a list of pages from a search of page tags.

Name: Tags
Description: Associate tags with a page.
TemplateText: ##Tags(These, are, the, tags, we, want, to, add)

Name: Tags
Description: Display the tags associated with the page.

Name: Template
Description: Processing instruction indicating the page is a template.

Name: TextGlossary
Description: Create a glossary from a search of wiki body contens.

Name: Title
Description: Sets the title of the page for the browser (HTML head title).

Name: Title
Description: Displays the title of the wiki page in title format.

Name: TOC
Description: Generate a table-of-contents for a page from the headings.
